tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/cache-eviction.md <<'EOF'
# Cache eviction policy

The project's current recorded decision is to use an LRU (least recently used) eviction policy with a TTL of 300 seconds, chosen because it is easier to reason about and to tune.
EOF
cat docs/policies/cache-eviction.md
